summary: Turn godot/mock/crossing_mock_world.json into a derived artefact with a generator and a drift check

coordination.notes: git grep -ln crossing_mock_world found only consumers (godot/README.md, world_root.gd, four godot/tests/*.gd) and no generator, so this is a new tool rather than an edit to one. The manifest builder tools/build-primitive-world-manifest.mjs is the upstream source; this tool runs it exactly the way tools/primitive-world-manifest-test.mjs does rather than reimplementing any of it, because data/world/out is gitignored and absent in a fresh worktree. The plan's draft named data/world/out/crossing-primitive-registry.json; the file the cells actually come from is 1-primitive-world.json, which the registry is an input to. No godot/*.gd or *.tscn was touched: the fixture is data, and plan-audit --claims shows no open claim on any godot/ path.

checks: node tools/build-godot-mock-fixture.mjs --check exit 0: OK godot/mock/crossing_mock_world.json matches a fresh generation (19 cells, root 1-14)

content proof: the regenerated fixture parsed, cells sorted by roomId and generatedFrom removed, is byte-identical to the committed blob at HEAD~1 - so the diff is cell order, the trailing newline, and a generator field, and no cell datum changed
cell set proof: BFS depth 2 from 1-14 over the full 1060-cell manifest yields exactly the 19 ids the fixture already had, neither more nor fewer

all eleven godot/tests/*.gd under Godot 4.3 against the regenerated fixture: 117 checks, 0 failed. live_bridge_transport_test.gd has no summary because it does not parse under 4.3 (OS.get_temp_dir does not exist there) - a pre-existing defect recorded in docs/verification/live-chain-2026-09-05.md, unchanged by this work.

sabotage: cell 1-13 deleted from the fixture -> foundation_test.gd 31 checked, 2 failed, and --check exit 1 naming line 160 as the first difference. Regenerated; md5sum -c matched. Without this the green run could not be distinguished from tests that never read the file.
